Dashon neumorphic dashboard

A Webflow dashboard experiment in which the frame, sidebar, cards, and bars all rise from one pale surface.

Source
Dashon dashboard experiment
Creator
Viktoria Kosmovich (as credited on the page)
Style
Neumorphism (agent-proposed, not yet reviewed by a person)
Moods
Soft, calm, quiet
Evidence
Captured with tools/capture.mjs (headless Chrome, 1440 × 900) on 28 September 2026 and inspected. The screenshot shows the first viewport; the measurement covers up to four screens.
Reviewed
28 September 2026
Rights
Third-party work, stored with credit for commentary. License: unverified. Rights policy

Observed

  • A large raised frame on a pale gray-blue page holds a sidebar and a grid of cards in the same color.
  • Four “Total Earns 2056” cards and four larger panels are raised; the active “Dashboard” item in the sidebar is a raised bar.
  • The search field, bell, gear, and user buttons at the top are small raised squares and pills.
  • Three progress tracks under “Best Selling Categories” are pressed wells with orange gradient fills. “on” in the Dashon logo is orange; text is dark navy sans-serif.

Why it belongs

A dashboard with few controls, one of the uses the style suits. The footer says it was “recreated for experimental purposes”, so it is a demonstration, not a product.

Measured: shadows on 84 % of boxes (median offset 4.2 px, median blur 15 px, none hard), borders on 4 %, median radius 10 px.
